name: brain_record
description: Start or stop the controller brain's lap recording view while the user drives the Thing.

name: brain_train
description: Start the controller brain training preview from the recorded lap samples and show its live loss curve.

name: autopilot_on
description: Show the learned-controller Autopilot preview in the controller brain view.

name: autopilot_off
description: Return the controller brain view from Autopilot preview to its ready state.

name: brain_status
description: Read the controller brain view state, current sample and whether it is a preview.
